items.title: Ken Peplowski interviewed by Monk Rowe, Aspen, Colorado, October 10, 1997 [interview 1 of 2]
items.q: Ralph Sutton has been a friend of mine and we’ve played together a lot so that’s the connection there.

ctx.x: It’s a combination of booking my own things, and I’ve got agents in different parts of the world. I’ve had a long lost search for a manager and it always ends in disaster. It’s very hard to find somebody that is trustworthy and that has the time to devote and that. I’ve had some experiences with managers in the past where after six months to a year you’re looking back at the year and you say well I’ve just paid this person a lot of money for things that I could have done myself. So I wind up taking everything…

the case with this festival. Ralph Sutton has been a friend of mine and we’ve played together a lot so that’s the connection there. And me getting out and trying to hustle jobs. Like I’ll do mailings to colleges or orchestras, I’m doing pops concerts now and things like that.
